title: Cardmember and Companion Holders: Reinstatement-Fee Rate on Crestline Credits
content:
**Condition.** The reinstatement-fee cardmember rate on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers depends on the customer's holdings of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes. The rate is **0.80** for a customer holding an active Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual or Crestline Companion Pass Annual. It is **0.90** for a customer holding no active companion pass but an active companion certificate issued as the co-branded card anniversary benefit. It is **1** for every other customer.

**What is read.** The customer's companion holdings: the product held, whether it is active, and, for a certificate, the ground on which it was issued.

## Holdings in combination

| Active Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual or Annual | Active companion certificate issued as the co-branded card anniversary benefit | Cardmember rate |
|---|---|---|
| held | held | 0.80 |
| held | not held | 0.80 |
| not held | held | 0.90 |
| not held | not held | 1 |

## Hypothetical holdings

- A customer holds a Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin issued as the co-branded card anniversary benefit, active, and no pass. The rate is 0.90.
- The same certificate, already used, with no pass. Nothing active is held, so the rate is 1.
- A customer holds a companion certificate issued as an elite choice benefit, active, and no pass. It was not issued as the co-branded card anniversary benefit, so the rate is 1.
